The noun usually stands at the end of the clause with the function verb in second position: 'Die Kommission zieht eine Verschiebung in Betracht.' In conversation a pile-up of them sounds heavy; the simple verb is often better there.
examples: The new regulation comes into force on 1 January.
We will gladly make the documents available to you.
The board is considering postponing the project.
This measure is intended to remedy the shortage of skilled workers.
The subject came up only briefly in the meeting.
pitfalls: The function verb is fixed: decisions are 'getroffen', not 'gemacht'.
'zur Sprache kommen' is passive-like (the question comes up); whoever raises something 'bringt' it up.
In the construction 'Kraft' has no article, and the noun of the construction goes to the end of the clause.

stilebenen-register.title: Style levels and register: elevated, neutral, colloquial
stilebenen-register.rule: Every word belongs to a style level: 'verscheiden' (elevated), 'sterben' (neutral), 'abkratzen' (crude). At C2 the task is no longer to be understood but to keep the level consistent. A register break occurs when colloquial words appear in a formal text ('echt', 'krass', 'hinkriegen', 'Sachen', 'kriegen', 'total') or when an everyday conversation suddenly sounds like officialese ('Ich bitte um Kenntnisnahme'). Marks of the formal register: nominalisations, passive and passive substitutes, the subjunctive of politeness ('Ich wäre Ihnen dankbar, wenn …'), verbs such as 'erhalten' instead of 'kriegen', 'bewältigen' instead of 'hinkriegen', 'tatsächlich' instead of 'echt', no modal particles like 'halt' and 'eh'. Marks of the spoken register: short main clauses, particles (doch, mal, eben), intensifiers, elements placed after the verb bracket. Different text types demand different levels: a complaint or an expert report elevated to neutral, an email to colleagues neutral, a chat with friends colloquial.
examples: I would be grateful if you could let me have the documents by Friday. (formal)
Can you send me the stuff by Friday? (spoken)
The administration has since dealt with the backlog. / They've managed it by now.
The deceased passed away peacefully yesterday. (elevated) / He died yesterday. (neutral)
pitfalls: 'echt' and 'hinkriegen' are colloquial and break the formal register set by the salutation.
'ersuchen um Übersendung' is officialese; among friends it sounds ironic or unintentionally funny.
'total kaputt' is colloquial; an expert report demands precise, neutral words like 'erheblich beschädigt' or 'nicht mehr tragfähig'.

erzaehltempora-erlebte-rede.title: Narrative tenses and free indirect speech (erlebte Rede)
erzaehltempora-erlebte-rede.rule: The narrative tense of written storytelling is the Präteritum; it marks narration rather than past time, which is why even 'morgen' can stand next to it: 'Morgen war Weihnachten.' What lies before the narrated action takes the Plusquamperfekt (anteriority); what still lies ahead from the character's point of view takes 'würde' + infinitive (posteriority). Erlebte Rede (free indirect speech) renders a character's thoughts without a reporting verb and without quotation marks: person and tense as in the narrator's report (third person, Präteritum), but word order, questions, exclamations and particles as in direct speech: 'Sie sah auf die Uhr. Warum kam er denn nicht? Er hatte es doch versprochen!' The narrator's voice and the character's voice merge; the reader learns the thoughts without their being marked as a quotation. To be distinguished from this are indirect speech in Konjunktiv I ('Sie fragte sich, warum er nicht komme') and direct speech with quotation marks and the present tense.
examples: When she arrived, the meeting had long since begun.
He packed his suitcase. In three days he would be in Lisbon.
She stared at the letter. What did this man actually want from her? She didn't even know him!
Tomorrow was the exam, and he hadn't even read half of it.
pitfalls: What precedes the narrated action takes the Plusquamperfekt; the Perfekt belongs to spoken German and breaks the narrative level.
In erlebte Rede the tense stays with the narrator's Präteritum; the present would signal direct speech, which needs quotation marks.
The future seen from a character's past point of view is expressed with 'würde' + infinitive, not with 'wird'.

gehobene-praepositionen.title: Elevated prepositions: mangels, ungeachtet, zufolge, seitens
gehobene-praepositionen.rule: Formal texts condense subordinate clauses with prepositions that hardly occur in conversation. With the genitive: angesichts (in view of), infolge (as a result of), mangels (for lack of), zwecks (for the purpose of), ungeachtet (notwithstanding), anlässlich (on the occasion of), seitens (on the part of), kraft (by virtue of), zugunsten / zuungunsten (in favour of / to the detriment of), mittels (by means of), hinsichtlich / bezüglich (with regard to), vorbehaltlich (subject to), binnen (within; genitive or dative). With the dative: gemäß, entsprechend, zuwider and zufolge, the last two usually placed after the noun: 'dem Bericht zufolge', 'dem Gesetz zuwider'. If a plural noun stands without article or adjective, the genitive is not visible and the dative steps in: 'mangels Beweisen', 'zwecks Verhandlungen' (but 'mangels eindeutiger Beweise'). These prepositions belong in expert reports, contracts and official letters; in spoken German they sound stiff, and a subordinate clause is used instead.
examples: For lack of clear evidence the proceedings were discontinued.
Notwithstanding all the protests, the senate stuck to the plan.
According to the report, the defects were already identified in 2019.
On the part of the management it was assured that no jobs would be cut.
For the purpose of clarifying the matter we request the documents within two weeks.
pitfalls: 'laut' and 'zufolge' mean the same; one is enough. 'zufolge' follows the noun and takes the dative.
'ungeachtet' takes the genitive: ungeachtet der Proteste.
'gemäß' takes the dative even though it sounds formal; the genitive is a widespread hypercorrection.

es-als-platzhalter-korrelat.title: 'es' as placeholder and correlate: Es wurde viel gelacht. Ich halte es für geboten, dass …
es-als-platzhalter-korrelat.rule: Besides the pronoun (Das Buch? Ich habe es gelesen) and the fixed 'es' of impersonal verbs (es regnet, es gibt, es geht um, es handelt sich um, mir ist es kalt), 'es' has two jobs that mark precise prose. First, as a placeholder in position 1: it occupies the front slot when the subject is to be moved back for weight – Es wurde viel gelacht. Es kamen mehr Gäste als erwartet. Es bleibt die Frage, ob … As soon as another element comes first, this 'es' vanishes without trace: Gestern wurde viel gelacht. It does not agree with the verb: Es kamen (plural!) mehr Gäste. Second, as a correlate announcing a subordinate or infinitive clause: Ich halte es für geboten, dass …; Sie hat es abgelehnt, den Vertrag zu unterschreiben; Es freut mich, dass … With verbs like bedauern, ablehnen, begrüßen, vermeiden, es für richtig halten the correlate in the middle field is obligatory (Ich bedaure es, dass …); with others (wissen, glauben, sagen) it is absent: Ich weiß, dass … (not: Ich weiß es, dass …). A correlate 'es' in the front slot disappears when the clause itself comes first: Dass er absagt, überrascht mich – not: Dass er absagt, es überrascht mich.
examples: Negotiations went on into the night without an agreement being reached.
Far more objections came in than the board had expected.
The council considers it imperative to postpone the decision.
That the study was never published explains a great deal.
pitfalls: The placeholder 'es' exists only in position 1; when something else is there, it disappears.
The placeholder 'es' is not the subject; the verb agrees with 'mehr Gäste' (plural).
With wissen, glauben, sagen, hoffen no correlate precedes the dass-clause.
When the clause comes first it fills the front slot itself; an extra 'es' would be a second element before the verb.

nachfeld-ausklammerung.title: The Nachfeld and extraposition: …, als wir dachten. Er hat lange gewartet – auf eine Antwort, die nie kam.
nachfeld-ausklammerung.rule: The German sentence is a bracket: the conjugated verb and the rest of the predicate (participle, infinitive, prefix) enclose the middle field – Er hat … gewartet. Whatever stands after the right bracket is in the Nachfeld. Subordinate and infinitive clauses belong there by nature (Er hat versprochen, dass er kommt), as do comparisons with 'als' and 'wie' (Es ist später geworden, als wir dachten) and afterthoughts (Sie hat alles verkauft, sogar die Bücher). Extraposition means deliberately placing an element after the bracket that would also fit inside: Er hat lange gewartet – auf eine Antwort, die nie kam. It lightens long or heavy elements (especially prepositional phrases with a relative clause), stresses what is moved out and keeps the bracket short, so the listener does not reach the verb only after twenty words. Not extraposed: a bare accusative object, pronouns and short adverbs – 'Er hat gelesen das Buch' is wrong, even in speech. In administrative and academic prose the closed bracket is the norm; in speeches, journalism and literature deliberate extraposition is a stylistic device – deliberate, not habitual.
examples: The exhibition has grown larger than its curators ever planned.
The director spent two hours telling – of a childhood you would never guess at.
She sold everything, even her grandmother's piano.
I read the review, with growing unease.
pitfalls: A bare accusative object stays inside the bracket; what gets extraposed are heavy prepositional phrases, comparisons and afterthoughts.
The comparison with 'als' belongs in the Nachfeld, after the participle.
Pronominal adverbs (darauf, damit) and pronouns are not extraposed.
In an official letter the closed bracket is the norm; the dash with an afterthought is a device for speeches and the arts pages.

bakery.opening: Good morning! What can I get you?
beats: Certainly, six rolls. Would you like anything else?
The wholegrain loaf is 3.80 euros. Shall I slice it for you?
I'm afraid the pretzels are sold out today. Could I offer you something else instead?

cafe.opening: Hello, what can I bring you?
beats: Certainly, one cappuccino. Would you like a piece of cake with it?
Yes, oat milk is possible at no extra charge. Shall I make the cappuccino that way?
The apple cake is 4.20 euros a slice. Would you like it with cream?
I'm afraid it's cash only, we don't take cards. Do you happen to have the exact amount?

doctor_phone.situation: booking a doctor's appointment by phone
doctor_phone.role: the receptionist at a doctor's practice
doctor_phone.opening: Doctor's practice at the market square, good day. How can I help you?
beats: I'm sorry to hear that. The next free appointment is Thursday at 9, does that suit you?
Please bring your health insurance card and come ten minutes early. Have you been to our practice before?
We're here for you until 5 pm today. Is there anything else I can do for you?

train_ticket.situation: buying a train ticket at the station
train_ticket.opening: Good day, where would you like to travel?
beats: The next train to Hamburg leaves at 14:12 from platform 7. Would you like a one-way or a return ticket?
The one-way ticket costs 29 euros. Would you like to pay by card or in cash?
No, the train is direct, no changes. Do you also need a seat reservation?

supermarket.opening: Hello! Do you need a bag?
beats: The bag costs 20 cents. Do you collect points with a loyalty card?
Yes, card from 5 euros. Would you like the receipt?
The deposit machine is at the entrance; you get 25 cents back per bottle. Do you already have the deposit slip?

hotel_checkin.opening: Welcome! Do you have a reservation?
beats: Certainly. You have room 214 on the second floor; may I see your ID, please?
Breakfast is from 7 to 10 on the ground floor. Would you like the Wi-Fi password right away too?
The password is hotelgast2026, all lower case. Shall I show you the way to the elevator?
Check-out is by 11. Will you need a taxi on the day you leave?

pharmacy.situation: buying something for a cough at the pharmacy
pharmacy.opening: Good day, how can I help you?
beats: Yes, I can recommend a cough syrup; it costs 6.95 euros. Do you also have a fever?
Take one spoonful three times a day, ideally after meals. Are you taking any other medication?
No, the cough syrup is available without a prescription. May I add some throat lozenges for you?

restaurant_booking.situation: reserving a table at a restaurant
restaurant_booking.opening: Restaurant Linde, good evening. How can I help you?
beats: Certainly, on Saturday I still have a table for four at 7 pm. Does 7 pm suit you?
The kitchen is open until 10 pm, so you have plenty of time. Would you like to sit inside or on the terrace?
When it rains the terrace is closed, I'm afraid; then you get a table inside. What phone number can I reach you on?

directions.situation: asking the way to the town hall
beats: Go straight ahead here and then take the second street on the left. Do you want to walk or would you rather take the tram?
On foot it's about ten minutes. Do you have luggage with you?
Take line 4; the stop is right across the street. Do you already have a ticket?

late_friend.situation: apologising to a friend for being late
late_friend.opening: Hey, where are you? The film starts soon!
beats: No stress, the film doesn't start until 8. Shall I get you some popcorn already?
Yes, I've already got the tickets; we're in row 8. Where exactly are you now?
I'll wait for you at the entrance. Do you want something to drink too?

taxi.opening: Hello, where would you like to go?
beats: Certainly, to the Lindenhof at Gartenstraße 12. Do you have luggage for the boot?
The ride takes about 15 minutes. Shall I put the suitcase in the boot?
About 18 euros. Would you like to pay cash or by card?
No problem, you'll get the receipt at the end. Shall I drop you right in front of the hotel?

cinema.opening: Good evening, which film would you like tickets for?
beats: Certainly, two tickets for 8 pm. A ticket is 11 euros, 8 euros with a student card; do you have one with you?
Thanks, two reduced then. Where would you like to sit, row 7 in the middle or row 12 at the back?
The film is in German with English subtitles. Is that all right for you?
The screening starts at 8 pm. Did you know the film is shown in German with English subtitles?
That's no problem; within 14 days we take it back with the receipt. Do you have the receipt with you?
For returns we give a voucher, not cash; the voucher is valid for three years. Would you perhaps rather exchange the blouse for another size?
In M it's sold out, I'm afraid, but we still have size L. Would you like to try on the L?

bike_rental.opening: Hello! Would you like to rent a bike?
beats: A bike is 15 euros a day. Roughly how tall are you, so I can pick the right bike?
Yes, the deposit is 50 euros, cash or card. Would you like a helmet as well?
No, the helmet comes free. Do you already know where you'd like to ride?
Please bring the bike back by 7 pm, that's when we close. Shall I give you a lock as well?

post_office.opening: Good day, what can I do for you?
beats: As a small parcel to Spain that's 9.49 euros. Is there anything fragile inside?
The parcel takes four to six working days. Would you rather send it as a tracked parcel?
With tracking it's 13.99 euros; then you can see online where it is. Shall I book it that way?
No, within the EU no customs form is needed. Would you like the receipt printed or by email?

buergeramt.situation: registering your address at the citizens' office
buergeramt.opening: Good day, it's your turn. What is it about?
beats: Certainly, registration is free of charge. Do you have your ID card and the landlord's confirmation with you?
It's a form your landlord signs; without it the registration can't go ahead, I'm afraid. Could you hand it in with an online appointment?
You have 14 days after moving. When did you move in?

hairdresser.opening: Hello, do you have an appointment?
beats: Without an appointment you'd wait about 20 minutes, or I can book you in for 3 pm. Which do you prefer?
A haircut is 24 euros, 32 with a wash. Would you like your hair washed first?
Right, I'll leave the sides a bit longer. How much should come off the top, about two centimetres?
Yes, you can pay cash or by card. Please take a seat here at the front; would you like something to drink?

landlord_washing.situation: asking the caretaker about the laundry room
landlord_washing.opening: Hi! You're the new tenant from the third floor, right?
beats: There's a washing machine in the basement; one wash costs 2 euros in coins. Do you have the basement key yet?
You can wash from 7 am to 9 pm; after that the house is quiet. Are you on the washing rota yet?
The rota is on the laundry room door; just put your name down there. Do you need the dryer too?
The dryer is broken, I'm afraid; the repair comes on Wednesday. Can you manage with the drying rack until then?

flatmate_kitchen.situation: discussing kitchen rules with your flatmate
flatmate_kitchen.opening: Hey, great that you're here! Have you unpacked everything yet?
beats: We clean the kitchen every Sunday, taking turns. Does that work for you, or are you usually busy on Sundays?
Yes, we have a kitty; everyone puts in 10 euros a month. Is that okay with you?
We start the dishwasher in the evening when it's full. Do you like cooking, by the way?
Sure, just give us a quick heads-up beforehand. Shall we cook together tomorrow?

lost_property.situation: asking about a lost bag at the lost-property office
lost_property.opening: Good day, what have you lost?
beats: A black bag from yesterday is indeed here with us. What was inside, so I can match it?
Yes, to collect it I just need your ID. Do you have it with you?
There's a 5 euro fee for storage. Would you like a receipt for it?

cold_soup.situation: complaining about cold soup at a restaurant
beats: I'm very sorry; I'll bring you a fresh soup in about five minutes. May I bring you a drink on the house in the meantime?
No, of course we'll take the soup off the bill. Would you like to see a dessert afterwards?
Today we have apple strudel, fresh from the oven. Shall I bring you one with vanilla sauce?

neighbour_plants.situation: asking your neighbour to water your plants
neighbour_plants.learner: the neighbour from across the hall
neighbour_plants.opening: Good evening! You wanted to ask me something?
beats: Gladly, but from Monday to Wednesday I'm away myself. Is it enough if I water from Thursday?
Best give me the key on Friday; we'll see each other then anyway. Shall I bring in your mail as well?
I'll just put the mail in the hallway, so you find it right away. How often should I water, twice a week?

cafe_job.situation: applying for a job at a café
cafe_job.opening: Hello, good that you're here. You're interested in the position in service?
beats: We're looking for someone for the weekend, 9 to 3 each day. Does that work for you time-wise?
You get 14 euros an hour, plus tips on top. Have you worked in service before?
No, experience isn't necessary; we'll show you everything. Would you have time for a trial shift on Saturday?

library.opening: Hello, how can I help you?
beats: Certainly, you need your ID and a registration certificate. Do you have both with you?
The annual fee is 20 euros, 10 euros reduced. Would a reduction apply to you?
The loan period is 4 weeks, and you can renew twice. Shall I issue the card right away?
Up to 20 items at a time, and we're open Monday to Saturday from 10 to 19 h. Do you have any other question?

dentist.opening: Hello, please take a seat. Where exactly does it hurt?
beats: Let's have a look then, please open wide. Does it hurt when I press here?
There's a small hole, that needs a filling. Shall I do it today right away?
Don't worry, you'll get an injection, which works after about 5 minutes. Are you allergic to any anaesthetic?
No, that's covered by the insurance with no co-payment. Afterwards please don't eat for two hours; do you have any questions?

mobile_cancel.opening: Good day, you're through to customer service. How can I help you?
beats: I can prepare that for you. May I ask why you'd like to cancel?
The notice period is one month, so your contract would end on 31 March. Shall I register the cancellation for that date?
The cancellation has to come in writing or online via your customer account; the call alone isn't enough, I'm afraid. Do you have access to the customer account?
Taking your number with you is free; your new provider simply requests it from us. Would you like a confirmation by email as well?

bank_account.opening: Good day, please take a seat. What can I do for you?
beats: The account is free if at least 700 euros come in each month; otherwise it costs 4.90 euros a month. Will your salary go into the account regularly?
I need your ID and a current registration certificate. Do you have both with you today?
The bank card arrives by post in five to seven days; the PIN comes separately. Would you like online banking activated as well?
An overdraft is possible after three months if the salary comes in regularly. Shall I note an appointment for that already?

garage.situation: asking the garage about a car repair
garage.opening: Good day, you're here about the blue estate car, right?
beats: Yes, the front brakes are worn, that's the noise. Have you been driving a lot in the city lately?
With parts and labour we come to about 280 euros. Shall I do the brakes right away?
The car will be ready tomorrow afternoon; I'll call you as soon as it's done. Can you manage without a car until then?
Unfortunately no courtesy car is free right now; they're all out. Shall I call you a taxi?

hotel_noise.situation: complaining about noise at a hotel
hotel_noise.opening: Good evening, what can I do for you?
beats: I'm sorry, that's the building site next door; work starts at 7, unfortunately. Would you like to move to a quieter room?
Yes, room 512 on the fifth floor is free; it's on the quiet side. Shall I help you move your luggage?
Of course, tomorrow's breakfast is on the house. Is there anything else I can do for you?

sick_call.opening: Hi, Anna here. You don't sound good at all, what's wrong?
beats: Oh no, then get well first. How long do you expect to be off?
From the third day we need a sick note; just send it by e-mail to personal@firma.de. Are you seeing the doctor today?
Sara will take the client meeting on Thursday at 10. Can you quickly send her the current documents?
Yes, drop me a line on Wednesday whether you'll be back on Thursday. Do you need anything else from us?

travel_centre.situation: a missed connection at the travel centre
travel_centre.opening: Hello, what can I do for you?
beats: I'm sorry, the next train to Hamburg leaves at 17:42 from platform 9. May I see your ticket for a moment?
Your ticket remains valid, the train restriction is lifted. Are you travelling through to Hamburg today?
From 60 minutes' delay at your destination you get 25 percent of the fare back. Would you like to take the passenger-rights form with you now?
Yes, I'll confirm the delay for you here on the form. Do you have any other question about your onward journey?

job_interview.situation: a job interview at a logistics company
job_interview.opening: Good afternoon, good to have you here. Tell me a little about yourself first – what brought you to us?
beats: That fits well, as we are looking for a full-time customer service clerk. What attracts you to this position in particular?
The position is available from 1 March; the probation period is six months. Would that date work for you?
We offer 3,400 euros gross per month, plus two days of working from home per week after probation. Does that match your expectations?
After probation you can work from home two days a week. Do you have any further questions for us?

flat_viewing.situation: viewing a flat with the estate agent
flat_viewing.opening: Good afternoon, come in. How do you like the flat at first sight?
beats: The rent is 890 euros excluding bills, plus 180 euros of service charges a month, heating included. Does that fit your budget?
The deposit is three months' rent. From when would you want to move in?
The flat is available from 1 July. Would you like to apply for it right away?
I need proof of salary for the last three months and a certificate from your current landlord that you have no rent arrears. Could you email me the documents?

utility_bill.situation: complaining about an electricity bill by phone
utility_bill.opening: Municipal utilities customer service, good morning. What can I do for you?
beats: I'll gladly look into that. I see an additional payment of 412 euros based on an estimated meter reading, as we had no reading from you. Could you give me your customer number, please?
Exactly, the meter reading was estimated. If you report the current reading to me, the bill will be recalculated. Do you have the meter within reach right now?
No, payment is suspended until the recalculation, and you can lodge an objection within four weeks. Shall I send you the confirmation by email?

immigration_office.situation: an appointment at the immigration office to extend a residence permit
immigration_office.opening: Good morning, you have an appointment to extend your residence permit. Do you have your passport and the application with you?
beats: Thank you. For the extension of the residence permit for employment I still need the tenancy agreement and a current proof of health insurance. Can you submit those two documents later?
The fee is 98 euros and is paid at the machine on the ground floor. Would you like to do that right after our appointment?
Processing takes about six weeks. Until then you receive an interim certificate today that is valid until the decision. Shall I print it straight away?
The interim certificate is valid until the decision, so your current rights remain in place. Do you have any other questions about the procedure?

parcel_complaint.situation: complaining by phone about a damaged delivery
parcel_complaint.opening: Customer service, hello. How can I help you?
beats: I'm very sorry about that. So that I can log the case: could you give me your order number, please?
Thank you, I've found order 771325. I can offer you a replacement within three working days or a refund. Which would you prefer?
No return is necessary; a photo of the damage is enough for us. Could you send the photo to our service address?
Of course, as an apology you'll receive a 10-euro voucher for your next order. Is there anything else I can do for you?

flat_handover.situation: the flat handover and the deposit
flat_handover.opening: Hello, let's go through the flat together then. Do you have all the keys with you?
beats: The report covers the meter readings, electricity 45210 and water 812, the keys and all defects. Have you already filled the drill holes in the living room?
I'll check that in the move-in report right away; then we'll record the scratches as pre-existing. Do you agree to our photographing both?
We return the 1800-euro deposit within six weeks of the handover. Which account should the transfer go to?
We may hold back a partial amount until the service-charge statement; the rest comes within the six weeks. Would you like to sign the report now or read it calmly first?

internet_hotline.situation: reporting an internet outage to the hotline
internet_hotline.opening: Hello, customer service. What's your customer number?
beats: Thanks, I have your line in front of me. Is the DSL light on the router red, or is it blinking?
Then it's not on your side: there's a known fault in the street cabinet, and the repair is scheduled for tomorrow by 12 noon. Do you need an alternative until then?
I'll activate 10 GB of LTE data for you free of charge; you'll get the access code by text. Shall I do that right away?
Then call back with ticket number ST-2093 and we'll send a technician on Friday between 8 and 12. Does that time window work for you?

salary_negotiation.situation: a salary negotiation in the annual review
salary_negotiation.opening: Good that we're taking the time. You had indicated that you would like to talk about your salary – where would you like to start?
beats: Your performance is undisputed, I see it the same way. However, our room for manoeuvre this year is at most 5 percent – what order of magnitude did you have in mind?
More would only be conceivable if you took over the project lead for the new customer portal. Could you see yourself doing that?
The adjustment would take effect from 1 July, as soon as the budget is approved. Would that be acceptable for you?
Alternatively I could offer you an additional day of leave and a training budget of 1,500 euros. Shall I put both in writing for you by the end of the week?

rent_increase.situation: advice at the tenants' association about a rent increase
rent_increase.role: the adviser at the tenants' association
rent_increase.opening: Good afternoon, do sit down. So you've received a letter from your landlord – what increase is it about exactly?
beats: That sounds like it exceeds the cap, because in this city the rent may rise by at most 15 percent within three years. When was the last increase?
No, an increase must be justified in writing, for instance with the rent index or with comparable flats; otherwise it is invalid. Do you have the letter with you?
According to the rent index, the standard local comparative rent for your location is 9.80 euros per square metre. How much do you pay at the moment?
You only have to consent by the end of the month after next; until then we will examine the letter. Membership costs 90 euros a year, legal protection included – would you like to join today?

town_hall_traffic.situation: a public meeting on the new traffic plan
town_hall_traffic.opening: Good evening and thank you for coming in such numbers. I'll present the plan in a moment – is there a question from the residents beforehand?
beats: Gladly: the plan provides for a 30 km/h limit on all streets in the district, complemented by wider pavements at the schools. Which street do you mean in particular?
It is true that 120 parking spaces will go; in return, a neighbourhood multi-storey car park will be built at the station. Would you use such an option?
Yes, line 7 will run every ten minutes in future, also at the weekend. Would that be sufficient for your journeys?
Construction is planned to start in spring and the works will take about 18 months. The planning office accepts objections in writing until 30 September – may I give you the form to take with you?

press_interview_study.situation: a newspaper interview about your own study
press_interview_study.opening: Thank you for taking the time. Before we begin with the questions about the study, would you like to know anything about the framework of the conversation first?
beats: The science page of the Saturday edition is planned. Would it suit you if we clarified the key findings right at the start?
We have about 6,000 characters, plus an info box on the methodology. Which limitation of your data must on no account be missing from it?
Of course, I'll send you the verbatim quotes for approval, but I need your feedback by Thursday, 12 o'clock. Is that feasible?
Yes, a statistician from the University of Bremen will be quoted with a critical assessment. Would you like to respond to that in advance during the conversation?
Right afterwards we'll take a few photos in the courtyard, that takes about 15 minutes. Does that suit you time-wise?

publishing_contract.situation: negotiating a publishing contract for a non-fiction book
publishing_contract.opening: Good to have you here, we are very much looking forward to the book. I have the draft contract with me – what would you like to start with, the royalties or the schedule?
beats: We offer an advance of 4,000 euros, payable in two instalments, on signing the contract and on delivery of the manuscript. Does that match your expectations?
Our usual rate is 10 percent of the net retail price; from 5,000 copies sold the rate rises to 12 percent. Would you have any objection to this scale?
We are counting on delivery of the manuscript by 31 March so that the book can appear in the autumn list. Is this schedule realistic for you?
Audiobook and e-book would lie with the publisher, the rights to foreign-language editions would stay with you. Would that be acceptable to you?
We decide the title together, but the final say rests with the publisher. Can you live with this arrangement?

tax_office_objection.situation: an objection to a tax assessment at the tax office
tax_office_objection.opening: Good afternoon, you had asked for a meeting about your tax assessment. What is your main concern, the additional payment or the reasoning behind the assessment?
beats: The travel costs were only recognised by half because the receipts for the second half of the year are missing. Do you have these documents by now?
The objection period is one month from notification of the assessment, so in your case until 14 May. Would you like to put the objection on record today?
The simplest way is via the ELSTER online portal, but you can also send them by post, as long as they arrive before the deadline. Do you already have access to the portal?

The objection by itself does not postpone the payment, but you can apply for suspension of enforcement; then the additional payment of 1,240 euros is deferred until the decision. Shall I include the application right away?
From experience, about six to eight weeks after receipt of the documents. Shall I send you the confirmation of receipt by post or electronically?

rules.impersonal-dative: Bodily sensations and well-being take a dative experiencer: mir ist kalt, mir geht es gut.
rules.preposition-case: The preposition sets the case: aus, bei, mit, nach, von and zu take the dative.
rules.tense-seit: What still continues is in the present tense with 'seit'; 'seit' takes the dative: seit drei Jahren.
rules.accusative-object: The direct object is accusative; masculine articles there end in -en: einen Hund, meinen Freund.
rules.place-preposition: Direction and location use different words: nach Hause / zu Hause, wohin / wo, nach Berlin / in die Schweiz.
rules.bracket: Participle, infinitive and separable prefix close the clause; objects and adverbials come before them, inside the verb bracket.
rules.noun-gender: Article and ending follow the noun's gender: der Name, die Idee, das Ergebnis.
rules.idiom: This is a fixed expression; it is not translated word for word from English.
rules.negation: Negate only once: 'nicht' follows the object, and a noun without an article is negated with 'kein'.
rules.dative-verb: Verbs like helfen, danken, zustimmen and erklären (the person) take the dative: mir, dir, meinem Bruder.
rules.verb-second: In a main clause the finite verb is in second position, also after dann, deswegen or desto.
rules.verb-final: In a subordinate clause with dass, weil, wenn, ob, a question word or a relative pronoun, the finite verb goes to the end.
rules.da-compound: Before a dass- or infinitive clause the prepositional object becomes a da-compound: darauf, dafür, darüber.
rules.verb-preposition: Verb and preposition form a fixed pair that is not translated: warten auf, Angst vor, sich bewerben um, sich beschäftigen mit.
rules.comparison: The comparative takes -er and compares with 'als'; 'mehr' and 'wie' do not belong. Equality: so … wie.
rules.konjunktiv-2: Wishes and unreal conditions use Konjunktiv II: 'hätte gern' before a noun, 'würde gern' before an infinitive, 'hätte' and 'wäre' instead of 'würde haben' and 'würde sein'.
rules.konjunktiv-1: Reported speech uses Konjunktiv I (sei, habe, komme), not Konjunktiv II; in a dass-clause the verb goes to the end.
rules.infinitive-form: Modal verbs and 'lassen' take the bare infinitive (also in the perfect: musste, schneiden lassen), other verbs 'zu' + infinitive; a second auxiliary such as 'worden' or 'wird' is dropped.
rules.word-choice: A different word is needed; the English meaning does not carry over directly: interessant, wissen, sich lohnen, sinnvoll.
rules.tekamolo: Adverbials follow the order time, cause, manner, place (TeKaMoLo).
rules.relative-pronoun: The relative pronoun takes its gender from the noun and its case from the verb or preposition in the relative clause: der Mann, den ich sah; die Frage, auf die ich keine Antwort habe.
rules.redundancy: One connector is enough: obwohl without aber, einerseits without aber, anbei without im Anhang, deshalb without aus diesem Grund.
rules.conjunction-choice: 'obwohl' opens a subordinate clause, 'trotzdem' a main clause; after 'Der Grund ist' use 'dass', not 'weil'.
rules.reflexive: The verb is reflexive: sich entscheiden, sich erinnern an, sich konzentrieren auf, sich beeilen, sich erkälten.
rules.fronted-adverbial: A fronted adverbial fills the first position: the verb follows immediately, with no comma.
rules.genitive: 'wegen', 'trotz' and 'während' take the genitive (wegen des Regens); 'der Meinung sein' is genitive.
rules.agreement: Verb and endings agree with the subject: 'die Anzahl' is singular (hat); an adjective before its noun takes the matching ending (die geplanten Maßnahmen).
rules.clause-form: 'damit einverstanden sein' is followed by a dass-clause with a finite verb, not an infinitive: …, dass die Gebühren erhöht werden.
rules.passive: The passive takes one auxiliary: preterite 'wurden … geschlossen' or perfect 'sind … geschlossen worden', not both.
rules.style-chain: Chains of dass- and was-clauses are clumsy; one main clause with a noun phrase or 'und damit' says it more briefly.

ruleTitles.verb-final: The verb goes to the end

A1.name: Beginner
A1.canDo: Introduce yourself, order food, ask simple questions about prices and times.
A1.exampleGloss: My name is Sam and I live in Cologne.

A2.name: Elementary
A2.canDo: Talk about your day and your past weekend, make appointments, write short messages.
A2.exampleGloss: At the weekend I went to the cinema with friends.

B1.name: Intermediate
B1.canDo: Handle everyday situations on your own, give reasons and opinions, write personal and simple formal emails.
B1.exampleGloss: I could not come because I had to work longer.

B2.name: Upper intermediate
B2.canDo: Discuss abstract topics, argue for and against, write clear formal complaints and applications.
B2.exampleGloss: Although the rent has gone up, I would like to keep the flat.

C1.name: Advanced
C1.canDo: Follow demanding texts and talks, argue a position with nuance, write well-structured essays, reports and formal statements.
C1.exampleGloss: In view of rising rents, many are demanding that housing construction be speeded up.

C2.name: Mastery
C2.canDo: Understand practically everything you read or hear, weigh up arguments from several sources, and express fine shades of meaning in any register, from a formal objection to a review.

points: ask how to send it back

the legal basis and the ruling you rely on
the demand for a refund with a deadline
the steps you will take if the bank does not comply

the evidence or experience you draw on
